QF.id: AIFM CIII Fund Monitoring Reporting and Exit_29

question.text: During the Liquidation Period of a close-ended Cat III AIF, in-specie distribution of unliquidated investments requires approval of:

answer.text: At least 75% of investors by value

explanation.text: The Logic: During the Liquidation Period of a close-ended Cat III AIF, in-specie distribution of unliquidated investments requires approval of AT LEAST 75% of investors BY VALUE of their investment. The AIF must also arrange bids for at least 25% of unliquidated-investment value. The Trap: Two-thirds (B) is fund-tenure-extension threshold (different). Simple majority (A) and unanimity (D) are wrong. Note: The workbook fixes the 75% approval and 25% bid-arrangement rules for in-specie distribution; merchant-banker engagement and pool-allocation process advice is not part of the syllabus.
